chunks: For your Lord will have commanded it.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean when the Quran says Allah 'commanded' the earth?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the personification of the earth as a conscious entity responding to Allah's command, emphasizing divine sovereignty over creation. The term *wahy* here signifies a direct, authoritative instruction, reinforcing the concept of *Tawhid* in action where all natural phenomena obey God's will. This perspective is often linked with the idea of the earth bearing witness to human deeds, as seen in the subsequent verses. } [ {
